"""Run the frozen inspected-input compilation-scoped commutation diagnostic once."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,hashlib,itertools,json,platform,subprocess,sys,types
from copy import deepcopy
from contextlib import nullcontext
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch
import flagquantum
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization import pipeline
CANDIDATE_SCOPE=pipeline._reuse_commutation_analysis
BASE='5b9cf3878664393e8667ca175ec8669f37fb3bc9'
HARNESS='9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144'
WORKFLOWS=('flagquantum-ordinary-restored','flagquantum-target-artifact')
FILES=('flagquantum/compiler/optimization/commutation.py','flagquantum/compiler/optimization/pipeline.py','tests/unit/test_compilation_commutation.py','tests/unit/test_compile_scoped_commutation.py','docs/development/COMPILER_SCOPED_COMMUTATION_REUSE.md','docs/development/evidence/commutation-duplicate-census.json')
def git(root,*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=root,text=True,timeout=20).strip()
def canonical(value):return json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
def digest(value):return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value).encode()).hexdigest()
def save(path,report,first=False):
 data=(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode()
 if len(data)>64*1024*1024:raise RuntimeError('Diagnostic archive exceeds its declared 64 MiB disk budget')
 if first:
  with path.open('xb') as stream:stream.write(data)
 else:
  temporary=path.with_suffix('.pending');temporary.write_bytes(data);temporary.replace(path)
def main():
 parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--manifest',type=Path,required=True);parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
 root=Path.cwd();manifest=json.loads(args.manifest.read_text());harness=Path(manifest['source_checkout'])
 assert Path(flagquantum.__file__).resolve().parents[1]==root
 assert git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD')==manifest['implementation_commit']
 assert not git(root,'status','--porcelain')
 assert git(root,'diff','--name-only',BASE,'--','flagquantum')=='flagquantum/compiler/optimization/commutation.py\nflagquantum/compiler/optimization/pipeline.py'
 assert git(harness,'rev-parse','HEAD')==HARNESS and not git(harness,'status','--porcelain')
 assert manifest['base_commit']==BASE and manifest['source_commit']==HARNESS
 assert len(bytes.fromhex(manifest['input_nonce']))==32 and manifest['compiler_seed']==11
 assert manifest['input_status'] in ('inspected','fresh draw frozen after publication')
 if manifest['input_status']=='inspected':assert manifest['input_nonce']=='01'*32
 assert manifest['driver_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 for name in FILES:assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==manifest['files_sha256'][name]
 assert manifest['versions']=={name:version(name) for name in ('torch','numpy','qiskit','cirq-core')}
 sys.path.insert(0,str(harness/'src'))
 from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter,workflow_configuration
 from sdkbench.candidates.applications import WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,fixture
 from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
 from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
 assert tuple(WIDTHS)==(6,8,12) and len(FAMILIES)==5 and len(TOPOLOGIES)==4
 configs={name:workflow_configuration(name) for name in WORKFLOWS}
 assert configs==manifest['configurations']
 bundle=Bundle(harness/'docs/implementation')
 report={'scope':'Complete compilation-scoped commutation-reuse diagnostic; exact output equality required; no cross-SDK ranking','implementation_commit':manifest['implementation_commit'],'base_commit':BASE,'source_commit':HARNESS,'manifest':manifest,'python':sys.version,'platform':platform.platform(),'completed':False,'rows':[],'inputs':[],'payloads':{},'runner_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
 save(args.output,report,first=True)
 for case_index,(width,family,topology) in enumerate(itertools.product(WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES)):
  source=fixture(width,family,topology,manifest['input_nonce']);identity=f'{width:02d}/{family}/{topology}'
  report['inputs'].append({'case':identity,'fixture_sha256':digest(source)})
  acceptance=bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width==8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
  for workflow in WORKFLOWS:
   variants=('baseline','candidate') if case_index%2==0 else ('candidate','baseline')
   for variant in variants:
    row={'case':identity,'workflow':workflow,'variant':variant,'seed':11,'status':'failed'}
    try:
     config=configs[workflow]
     adapter=load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options':{'sdk':config['sdk'],'workflow':workflow,'compiler_options':deepcopy(config)}}))
     case_source=deepcopy(source)
     scope=nullcontext if variant=='baseline' else CANDIDATE_SCOPE
     with patch.object(pipeline,'_reuse_commutation_analysis',scope):payload=adapter.execute('route',case_source,11)
     normalized=canonical({key:payload[key] for key in ('operations','final_layout')})
     payload_hash=hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode()).hexdigest();report['payloads'][payload_hash]=normalized
     row.update(payload_sha256=payload_hash,compile_wall_seconds=payload['compile_wall_seconds'],audit=dict(adapter.audit))
     assert digest(case_source)==digest(source),'Adapter mutated the fixture'
     row['metrics']=routing(payload,source,None,acceptance,0)
     assert payload['final_layout']==list(range(width)),'Delivered final layout is not identity'
     row['status']='accepted'
    except Exception as error:
     row.update(error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error))
    report['rows'].append(row)
  save(args.output,report)
  print(json.dumps({'phase':'acceptance','case':identity,'attempted':len(report['rows']),'failures':sum(r['status']!='accepted' for r in report['rows'])}),flush=True)
 assert len(report['rows'])==240 and len(report['inputs'])==60
 assert not git(root,'status','--porcelain')
 assert git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD')==manifest['implementation_commit']
 paired={}
 for row in report['rows']:paired.setdefault((row['case'],row['workflow']),{})[row['variant']]=row
 report['exact_pair_mismatches']=[]
 for key,rows in paired.items():
  if any(rows[v]['status']!='accepted' for v in ('baseline','candidate')) or any(rows['baseline'].get(field)!=rows['candidate'].get(field) for field in ('payload_sha256','audit','metrics')):report['exact_pair_mismatches'].append(list(key))
 report['completed']=True;save(args.output,report)
 if report['exact_pair_mismatches']:raise SystemExit(2)
 if any(r['status']!='accepted' for r in report['rows']):raise SystemExit(1)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
